top_choice_rationale: The GLP-1 work is a mature, transformative achievement: Drucker, Holst and Mojsov established the physiology of GLP-1 and its biologically active form, which directly enabled incretin-based therapy that has changed treatment of type 2 diabetes and obesity worldwide. The three-laureate allocation with the physiology-and-active-form citation fits the discovery scope and keeps the clinical-development layer outside the citation. An award this well established is preferable to no award.
